The team's home ground is Sydney Showground Stadium, known as Spotless Stadium at Sydney Olympic Park.  Their team uniform is lime green.  Thunder won the fifth edition of Big Bash, as well as the inaugural Women's Big Bash League.
Hobart Hurricanes | The Hobart Hurricanes are an Australian professional men's Twenty20 cricket team based in Tasmania, Australia.  They compete in Australia's Twenty20 domestic cricket competition known as The Big Bash League, representing Hobart.  The Hurricanes play their home matches at Blundstone Arena.  The Hurricanes wear a purple cricket uniform.
